note: How a county board's yearly budget hearing and levy are set up. One reader for every county (src/simulation/living-world/county-budget-hearings.ts). Every value here is an estimate from a national average, marked as such; a state's own notice period or assessment ratio can replace one without a code change.

hearingLeadDays.source: Counties begin their budget process one to three months before the fiscal year opens. One hundred days is chosen so a levy passed at the hearing and its reading takes effect about when the fiscal year opens, because the tax seam delays every sourced tax change by ninety days (src/simulation/tax-policy.ts). Not yet read from any state's law.

personsPerHousehold.source: U.S. Census Bureau, ACS 2020-2024 five-year average household size.

ownerOccupiedShare.source: U.S. Census Bureau, ACS 2020-2024 owner-occupied housing unit rate.
